mapper.select: SELECT lr.*, TRIM(e.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(e.last_name, '')) AS employee_name, TRIM(mgr.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(mgr.last_name, '')) AS manager_name FROM leave_requests lr LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = lr.manager_id WHERE lr.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY lr.id DESC

SELECT lr.*, TRIM(e.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(e.last_name, '')) AS employee_name, TRIM(mgr.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(mgr.last_name, '')) AS manager_name FROM leave_requests lr LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = lr.manager_id WHERE lr.company_id = #{companyId} AND (lr.manager_id = #{managerEmployeeId} OR e.reporting_manager_id = #{managerEmployeeId}) ORDER BY lr.id DESC

SELECT lr.*, TRIM(e.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(e.last_name, '')) AS employee_name, TRIM(mgr.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(mgr.last_name, '')) AS manager_name FROM leave_requests lr LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = lr.manager_id WHERE lr.company_id = #{companyId} AND lr.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY lr.id DESC

SELECT lr.*, TRIM(e.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(e.last_name, '')) AS employee_name, TRIM(mgr.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(mgr.last_name, '')) AS manager_name FROM leave_requests lr LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id LEFT JOIN employees mgr ON mgr.id = lr.manager_id WHERE lr.id = #{id} AND lr.company_id = #{companyId}
